architecture_findings.finding: Child placement must compile in parent layout context; Row, Column, Align-to-Parent, and Fixed cannot share a context-free placement mapping.
Align-to-Parent needs an explicit overlap, pin, and stacking contract; a nine-cell value alone does not define collisions.
Fixed containers need a local containing block and explicit intrinsic-size policy because positioned children do not size the parent.
Viewport predicates must preserve ordered rules and inclusive boundaries independently from natural Row wrap transitions.
Hidden-and-collapsed must remain distinct from hidden-with-space because it changes gaps and intrinsic sizing.
Font metrics, image crop/focal data, and authorized reference geometry must be frozen before visual parity can be scored.
Production normalization must preserve sizing intent, style layers/provenance, unresolved rules, source refs, and unsupported values rather than this prototype's CSS-ready box values.
